item.title: RTT: Ref. 5301 - Digital Innovation and Public Regulation of the Insurance Market (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Forlì
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-03 Diritto dell'economia e dei mercati finanziari e agroalimentari

The project aims to analyze the new relationships between legal regime and economic dynamics within the insurance market resulting from digital innovations and information technologies, which are shaping new models of public regulation in this market. In this context, the project intends to examine the definition of these new models of public regulation, with particular attention to the evolution of European and national legal regulation of the insurance market, as well as to the new digital methods of supervising the economic actors operating within the market itself.

item.title: RTT: Criminal Procedure Law (Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 23:59
Institution: Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA, Chieti
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-13 Diritto processuale penale

research on the relationship between preliminary investigations and the quality of final judicial decisions, focusing on procedural dysfunctions that may affect judicial reasoning and decision-making. The first strand provides a systematic analysis of Book V of the Italian Code of Criminal Procedure in light of legal scholarship and constitutional and Supreme Court case-law, identifying deviant practices and critical issues in its application. The second adopts an interdisciplinary approach, combining legal analysis with research on cognition and decision-making biases, and statistical methods for the empirical study of judicial practices. item.title: RTT: Private Law (Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 23:59
Institution: Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA, Chieti
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-01 Diritto privato

The researcher will be required to conduct scientific research within the GIUR-01/A scientific-disciplinary sector, focusing on the theoretical, systematic and practical aspects of private law institutions. Despite the variety of topics, the research must pay particular attention to the evolution of civil law categories and emerging issues raised by social, economic, technological and regulatory changes within the Italian and European legal systems.

item.title: RTT: Business Law (Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 23:59
Institution: Univ. CHIETI-PESCARA, Chieti
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-02 Diritto commerciale e della navigazione

The researcher will be expected to conduct basic research in commercial law, particularly corporate law and bankruptcy law. The researcher will demonstrate research skills and experience, interpreting the relevant theoretical and practical case law. Regarding synthetic research, they will produce critical essays and commentaries on the research topics, aiming to produce a scientific output that will have a real impact on the scientific community
